location_banner_body: Nwala-d kečč/kem telliḍ di {countryName}. Tebɣiḍ ad twaliḍ agbur yettwassnen di tama-nwen?
about_p1: Di DeltaSilicon.Hub, numen belli assihrew ilaq ad yili s tussna, war ma yeḥbes, yerna mebla tuɣac n ussewjed. Tawuri-nneɣ d abeddel n wamek i d-ttafen medden agbur, s useqdec n teḥnacca n AI d usexdem yettxemmimen ɣef useqdac.
about_p2: Yebna-t-id yimussnawen n teḥnacca i iɣaḍen lḥal deg ayen yellan tura deg ussihrew. Nexdem-d anagraw i ifehmen s tidet d acu bɣan yimferrjen. Ulac anadi war tilisa, ulac aḥbas, ala assihrew i k/m-ilaqen.
vision_1: Adeg n ussihrew yesɛan tussna i ifehmen iseqdacen
vision_2: Kkes tuɣac n ussewjed s umata
vision_3: Ɛiwen imeskaren n ugbur s tukci n yedrimen d tlelli n uskar
vision_4: Sker tagrawla tamaḍlant s ussihrew yelhan
support_subtitle: Af tallalt i teḥwaǧeḍ i DeltaSilicon.Hub. Nella da ad k/m-nɛiwen.
email_support_desc: Azen-aɣ-d imayl, a k/m-nerr awal deg 24 n swayeɛ.
live_chat_desc: Meslay d wid ixeddmen ɣur-nneɣ iwakken ad tafḍ tallalt.
phone_support_desc: Ssiwel-aɣ-d deg wakud n leqdic ma tesɛiḍ ugur.
faq_q1: Amek ara sermeɣ isekkilen n tsuqilt?
faq_a1: Isekkilen n tsuqilt sɛan aṭas n tutlayin. Tekki ɣef te बटunt CC iwakken ad textareḍ tutlayt.
faq_q2: Acuɣer ur zmireɣ ara ad waliɣ kra n ugbur?
faq_a2: Agbur yezmer ad yemgarad seg tama ɣer tayeḍ. Beddel anagraw n ussihrew ma yella ugur.
faq_q3: Amek ara beddleɣ anagraw n ussihrew?
faq_a3: Ruḥ ɣer Iɣewwaṛen > Anagraw n Ussihrew, fren anagraw i tebɣiḍ.
faq_a4: Ih, amazray-ik yettwaseḥrez deg uselkim-ik. Tzemreḍ ad t-twaliḍ deg wexxam n Umazray.
favorites_description: Isura-k/m d tirisin-ik/im isteɛfaven ad d-banen da.
history_description: Amazray-ik/m n wayen twalaḍ ad d-iban da.
enable_location_prompt: Sermed tiɣmiwin n wadeg iwakken ad twaliḍ asebter-a.
